title: The Galaxy of Graduates has moved to the main site
lead: We are glad to say the Galaxy of Graduates no longer lives apart on Google Sites — it is here, on the school's own site.
A request: find your page and fill in the form. If it already exists, please add to it — you can now name your teachers, not only the head of the course.
searchPlaceholder: Start typing a first or last name
searchEmpty: Nobody found. Try another spelling or a maiden name.
searchNoProfile: the form is not filled in yet
featuresTitle: What the new version can do

features.title: A living galaxy
features.text: Graduates drift through our space of craft and memories!

features.title: Several photographs instead of one
features.text: A form can hold more than one photograph. They change right in flight, in chronological order — from a small child to a grown-up.

features.title: Teachers now have their own pages
features.text: Tap the head of the course or a teacher inside a graduate's card and the teacher's page opens — with a surprise on the right-hand side!

features.title: A group can have its own page
features.text: With repertoire by year and recordings, shared photographs, the cast of the course, its masters and teachers. A few groups have such a page so far; write to me to make one for yours.

features.title: New fields in the form
features.text: Teachers as a section of their own, next to the head of the course. Social links are no longer limited to Instagram and Facebook — YouTube works too. And a video card.

features.title: A searchable register
features.text: Search by name, filters by department and by whether a form is filled in, a scale of years. The address remembers both the filter and your place in the list, so that link can be shared too.

features.title: A page of your own once the form is filled in
features.text: It has its own address, and the link can be sent to anyone. Right now 90 graduates out of 514 have such a page — the rest are in the galaxy by name only.

note: You can fill in or extend your form at any time. If something is missing or wrong, write to us and we will fix it.
askHint: Hi!) Questions, corrections, a group page — write to me
